answer: Identity is bound to a signed measurement of the runtime that produced it, so two identities reporting the same measurement are counted as one voice no matter how many keys or balances sit behind them. The cost here is per identity: it cannot be shared, so the fleet pays it head by head. Think of a voyage burned into the silicon, an orchard that pools everyone sharing it, and a summit that counts pooled members once: the farm is rich in keys and poor in distinct voyage, and neither orchard nor summit can be faked.
